sources.title: Law No. 88-025: conditions of foreigner stay in Comoros
sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice of the Union of the Comoros
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Justice Ministry legal-text portal publishes the foreigner-entry law, its general foreign-national scope, visa rule, categories, authorities and airport/port rule for transit visas.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Tout étranger doit être muni ... d’un visa comorien; visa de transit ... délivré à l’aéroport ou au port.

sources.title: Comoros Ministry of Foreign Affairs e-Government: Foreigners services
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation of the Union of the Comoros
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Foreign Affairs Ministry e-Government subsite identifies its foreigner-services catalogue but currently publishes no service or nationality rule.
